How do you take a mobile app from a zero-dollar idea to $100,000 in revenue in just 70 days without starting out with a massive paid advertising budget? 

In this episode of the Superwall Podcast, consumer app founder Cedric breaks down the exact growth playbook behind Pepai—the peptide and GLP-1 tracking app taking over the health and fitness space. While competing platforms leaned heavily on traditional, expensive digital ad setups, Cedric took the exact opposite approach, building an organic influencer machine that completely dominated the niche. By understanding the unique mechanics of creator trust and high-intent audiences, he turned a simple utility tracker into a high-growth, six-figure operation as a college student.

We take a deep look into the precise backend systems powering this rapid scale. Cedric reveals the operational architecture of his outreach team, explaining how they manage over 1,000 creator messages per week and route high-performing talent into structured retainer and affiliate commission programs.
